title: Making Language the Low-Rate Code of Vision: Successive Refinement from Words to Pixels
abstract: arXiv:2610.16552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An ordered visual code lets a short prefix stand in for an image, and the training loss decides what that prefix contains. Under pixel reconstruction the first bits go to the directions of highest variance, and we prove that a caption can then be independent of the entire first half of a code that is rate-optimal for pixels at every length. In the rate-distortion sense a caption is therefore not the low-rate code of its image, unless the code is built to make it one. We study that construction and what it costs. We cast captioning and text-to-image generation as successive refinement under a distortion measure that changes along the code, from caption log-loss in the early stages to pixel distortion in the last, so that each stage is compared with its own optimum. translated_title: 让语言成为视觉的低码率编码：从词语到像素的逐次精化
translated_abstract: 一种有序的视觉编码允许用简短的前缀来表示图像，而训练损失决定了该前缀所包含的内容。在像素重建的目标下，最初的比特会被分配到方差最高的方向上，我们证明此时一段图像描述文本可以与一个在任意码长下都对像素率最优的编码的整个前半部分相互独立。因此，从率失真的意义上讲，图像描述文本并不是其图像的低码率编码，除非该编码被专门构造成如此。我们研究了这种构造及其代价。我们将图像描述生成与文生图任务形式化为一种逐次精化过程，其中的失真度量沿着编码而变化——从早期阶段的描述对数损失到最后阶段的像素失真——从而使每个阶段都与各自的最优解进行比较。将词语置于最前端，当且仅当各描述构成一个摘要链时，才不会在描述各阶段之间引入额外代价，而对像素的代价至多等于描述的不确定性下界所给出的量。
tldr: 该论文在率失真理论框架下证明仅靠像素重建训练的编码中描述文本并非图像的低码率编码，并提出将图像描述与文生图统一为失真度量随码长从描述损失过渡到像素失真的逐次精化构造，使语言真正成为视觉的低码率编码。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that captions are not low-rate codes of images under pixel-reconstruction-trained codes, and proposes a successive-refinement construction where the distortion measure evolves from caption log-loss to pixel distortion, making language truly the low-rate code of vision.
